title: Path to $3.50 — what the market price implies (reverse DCF)
reading: At r=15%, g=10%, the $3.50 price needs retained revenue of $198,837,703/yr — 8.6x today's R₀. At the current 33.37% capture and 15.39 bps fee rate that means $387.2B of annual Intents volume (8.5x today's annualised volume), or $49,654,806 of gross fees every 30 days. Capture alone cannot get there: with volume flat, the price needs a 285% capture rate — impossible. Even at 100% capture with volume flat, the DCF ceiling is $1.23 (35% of the price). The price is a bet on volume growth, not on retention.
